title: ai-badger skill extension descriptor
description: The activation contract for an extension shipped inside a skill, at features/<stack>/skills/<skill>/extensions/<ext>/extension.json. scaffold.py copies the extension with the skill, then prunes it unless every `requires` condition holds against the project's config (welcome-ai-badger/scripts/extensions.py::prune_inline_extensions).

skill.description: The base skill this extension attaches to. Must equal the <skill> directory name.

requires.description: Every condition must hold or the extension is pruned from the scaffold.

optional.description: Config keys the extension uses when present. Never gates activation; documented so a reader can see what enriches the extension.

condition.description: _shared.requirement_met syntax: 'stacks=dotnet' (equality, list membership), 'sourceControl.platform==github' (value equality), 'sourceControl.repoUrl' (presence), or sub-conditions joined by '||'.
